basis: The dashboard title explicitly states it covers only 'Selected High-Growth Quarters,' and the plot displays just five data points (Q2–Q6). There are no control groups, causal annotations, or full-quarter data tables. While the plotted points show a positive correlation between ad spend and sales, the sample is non-representative (high-growth only) and observational. Approving a 'broader ad-budget increase' based on a selected, non-causal subset is not justified by the visible evidence. Deferring to the next cycle ignores the available data. Holding and requesting full-data analysis is the appropriate decision because the current evidence is insufficient to support a broad budget change without representative or causal data.
